prompt: 开发一个标讯收藏功能。用户可以在标讯列表和详情页点击收藏按钮，把感兴趣的标讯加入个人收藏列表。已收藏的标讯在列表页显示收藏状态图标。收藏列表页面可以查看所有已收藏的标讯，支持按收藏时间排序和取消收藏。后端用 Spring Boot + MySQL，前端用 Vue 3 + Element Plus。前后端都加，用 speckit 全流程走一遍。

assertions.name: skill-invoked
assertions.description: The with-skill test invokes the speckit-chain skill via Skill tool

assertions.name: constitution-executed
assertions.check: .specify/memory/constitution.md exists or summary mentions constitution step

assertions.name: spec-created
assertions.check: A spec.md file exists under specs/ directory or summary mentions spec generation

assertions.name: plan-created
assertions.check: A plan.md file exists under specs/ directory or summary mentions plan generation

assertions.name: tasks-created
assertions.check: A tasks.md file exists under specs/ directory or summary mentions task generation

assertions.name: full-stack-coverage
assertions.description: Both frontend and backend are covered in the plan
assertions.check: Summary mentions both frontend/Vue and backend/Spring Boot

assertions.name: review-gates-presented
assertions.description: Review gates were presented to the user
assertions.check: Summary mentions presenting results for review at spec/task gates
